SELECT org_country, count(*) AS projects FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE org_country <> 'UNITED STATES' AND org_country <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the total of final penalties assessed in hazardous waste enforcement actions?
SELECT sum(try_cast(fmp_amount AS double)) AS total FROM govblock_environment.echo_rcra_enforcements
Which firms sponsor the pooled investment funds that benefit plans invest in most often?
SELECT dfe_p1_spons_name, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_nonprofits.dol_f_sch_d_part1 WHERE dfe_p1_spons_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many words do Florida's statutes run to in all?
SELECT sum(try_cast(word_count AS bigint)) AS words FROM govblock_law.law_combined WHERE state = 'fl' AND document_type = 'statute'
Which electric utilities had the most residential customers in 2020?

SELECT column02 AS utility, column06 AS state, try_cast(customers AS double) AS residential_customers FROM govblock_energy.eia861_sales_ult_cust_sheet_states WHERE column00 = '2020' AND column03 = 'A' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of registered committees lean Democratic, Republican or neither?
SELECT cmte_pty_affiliation, count(DISTINCT cmte_id) AS committees FROM govblock_fec.committees GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which turbine models are most common in Wyoming?
SELECT t_model, count(*) AS turbines FROM govblock_energy.wind_uswtdb_uswtdb_v WHERE t_state = 'WY' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the average severity score of a designated primary care shortage area?
Bcd Hpsa Fct Det Producer Prices
SELECT avg(try_cast(hpsa_score AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_health.hrsa_bcd_hpsa_fct_det_pc WHERE hpsa_status = 'Designated'
Which states have the most tax-exempt organisations?
SELECT state, count(*) AS organisations FROM govblock_nonprofits.irs_eo_bmf GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much more did medical care cost in 2024 than ten years before?
SELECT year, value FROM govblock_labor.bls_cu_data WHERE series_id = 'CUUR0000SAM' AND period = 'M13' AND cast(year AS varchar) IN ('2014', '2024') ORDER BY year
Which incorporated places in New York State are the most populous?
SELECT name, try_cast(popestimate2025 AS double) AS population FROM govblock_census.popest_sub_est WHERE cast(sumlev AS varchar) = '162' AND stname = 'New York' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the median home value in Westchester County, New York?
SELECT value FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 WHERE geo_id = '0500000US36119' AND variable = 'B25077_E001'
In which states did a 40-year-old pay the most for marketplace health insurance in 2021?

SELECT statecode, avg(try_cast(individualrate AS double)) AS avg_monthly_premium FROM govblock_health.marketplace_rate_puf WHERE cast(businessyear AS varchar) = '2021' AND age = '40' AND tobacco <> 'Tobacco User' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much marketable Treasury debt was outstanding at the end of 2024, in millions?
SELECT max(try_cast(total_mil_amt AS double)) AS marketable_millions FROM govblock_treasury.mspd_table_1 WHERE record_date = '2024-12-31' AND security_type_desc = 'Total Marketable'
In which states do Davis-Bacon determinations set the highest carpenter wages?

SELECT substr(wd_number, 1, 2) AS state, round(avg(try_cast(rate AS double)), 2) AS avg_rate FROM govblock_awards.sam_wd_dba_rates WHERE classification LIKE 'CARPENTER%' AND try_cast(rate AS double) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many filings in the notes data set came from companies in New York State?
SELECT count(*) AS filings FROM govblock_sec.sec_fsnds_sub WHERE stprba = 'NY'
Which Treasury securities set records for the largest amount offered at auction?
SELECT concat(security_term, ' ', security_type) AS security, try_cast(high_offer_amt AS double) AS record_offer FROM govblock_treasury.record_setting_auction ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
What share of Grants.gov opportunities are plain grants rather than cooperative agreements?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN fundinginstrumenttype = 'G' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_awards.grantsgov_opportunity_synopsis
What are the most common root causes of medical device recalls?
SELECT root_cause_description, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.fda_device_recall WHERE root_cause_description IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Treasury bill auctions were held in 2024?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_treasury.auctions_query WHERE security_type = 'Bill' AND substr(auction_date, 1, 4) = '2024'
Which states added the most wind capacity in 2021?
SELECT t_state, sum(try_cast(t_cap AS double)) / 1000 AS megawatts FROM govblock_energy.wind_uswtdb_uswtdb_v WHERE cast(p_year AS varchar) = '2021' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did debt held by the public change from January 2, 2020 to January 2, 2025?
SELECT record_date, try_cast(debt_held_public_amt AS double) AS held_by_public FROM govblock_treasury.debt_to_penny WHERE record_date IN ('2020-01-02', '2025-01-02') ORDER BY 1
Which journals have the most articles in PubMed?
SELECT journal_title, count(*) AS articles FROM govblock_health.pubmed_articles GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of hazardous waste inspections find a violation?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN found_violation = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_environment.echo_rcra_evaluations
Which physics institutions have the most papers in INSPIRE?
SELECT legacy_icn AS institution, try_cast(number_of_papers AS double) AS papers FROM govblock_scholarly.inspire_institutions ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
In how many counties does the map show at least one substation?
SELECT count(DISTINCT countyfips) AS n FROM govblock_siting.hifld_electric_substations
Which hazardous waste rules are violated most often?
SELECT violation_type_desc, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_rcra_violations WHERE violation_type_desc IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of e-filed nonprofit returns are full 990s, 990-EZs and private foundation 990-PFs?
SELECT return_type, count(*) AS filings FROM govblock_nonprofits.irs_990_index GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which states are home to the most benefit plan sponsors filing Form 5500?
SELECT spons_dfe_state, count(DISTINCT spons_dfe_ein) AS sponsors FROM govblock_nonprofits.dol_f_5500 WHERE spons_dfe_state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many PubChem compounds have aspirin as their parent compound?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_parent WHERE c1 = '2244'
What kinds of notices does SAM.gov carry most often: solicitations, awards or presolicitations?
SELECT type, count(*) AS notices FROM govblock_awards.sam_opportunities GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What do elementary school teachers earn at the 90th percentile nationally?
SELECT occ_title, a_pct90, a_median FROM govblock_labor.oes_all_data_m_sheet_a WHERE area_title = 'U.S.' AND occ_title LIKE 'Elementary School Teachers%' AND naics_title = 'Cross-industry' LIMIT 5
Which school districts received the most federal money in fiscal 2017?
SELECT name, stabbr, try_cast(tfedrev AS double) AS federal_revenue FROM govblock_education.ccd_sdf WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '17' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
